This export conformance is declared action, not implementation semantic proof.

declared_profile: Node/Bun/Turbo runner profile; values package Node>=22; planned/external entries exempt from function-export conformance.

ingress.stage: VS Code extension contribution and activation
ingress.behavior: Activation starts one CanLanguageClient. It selects the active Can document's local workspace folder, else first local workspace folder, else leaves process cwd unchanged. Workspace folder path becomes child cwd, enabling relative catalog discovery. An initial client is started during activation. Restart is explicit command, can.serverPath/traceServer configuration change, or reopen after client exit. Each restart invocation waits for its captured current client stop before starting a replacement; no global queue/serialization for overlapping restart invocations is visible. Providers are registered once and consult the current client. Open files are sent after initialize completes.
ingress.evidence: declared source behavior; startup mock harness contains folder-choice and reopen cases, not a VS Code GUI run

ingress.behavior: Providers send LSP method requests with VS Code document URI and positions; absent/dead client or rejected request resolves to no result. The extension drops malformed range/edit/location/provider items. Rename and quick-fix WorkspaceEdit accepts documentChanges and legacy changes, but toWorkspaceEdit does not inspect or enforce documentChanges.textDocument.version. Code action request sends empty diagnostics context. Semantic token data must be a nonnegative safe-integer array; it is forwarded as Uint32Array.
ingress.evidence: declared source behavior; conversion edge cases are not comprehensively covered by the listed extension startup harness

ingress.stage: CanLanguageClient process lifecycle and wire protocol
ingress.behavior: Spawns configured binary as `<serverPath> lsp` over stdio, uses UTF-8 byte Content-Length, performs initialize/initialized, sends full document text for open/change and versioned notifications, save and close. Stop sends shutdown then exit and uses two-second timeouts before killing. Unexpected child error/exit settles pending requests, disposes diagnostic collection and invokes onExit once. Incoming incomplete headers/bodies wait for more data; malformed JSON frames are discarded; unframed garbage and oversized frames are logged/dropped. Diagnostic ranges that fail basic nonnegative-integer validation are dropped; valid items are mapped into VS Code diagnostics.
ingress.evidence: declared source behavior; startup CJS harness mocks VS Code and child process; no external editor process execution inferred

ingress.stage: Compiler command entry, framing, envelope and lifecycle
ingress.behavior: Compiler reads byte-framed messages, rejects oversized/malformed framing, parses strict UTF-8 and JSON, validates JSON-RPC envelope then lifecycle then method params. Initialize admits one session; shutdown followed by exit returns 0, exit without shutdown returns 1. EOF and torn-header/body disconnect flush and return lifecycle code. Invalid JSON/UTF-8 gets parse error with null id; framing errors are skipped and loop continues. Unknown requests get method-not-found; unsupported cancellation is a no-op.
ingress.evidence: declared source behavior; compiler/tests/lsp_admission.rs contains real-binary process harness cases but was not run

ingress.stage: Open document state, versions, full sync and diagnostic publication
ingress.behavior: didOpen stores URI/version/text and queues analysis. didChange accepts full-text contentChanges only; range-bearing incremental changes are ignored. For a batch of changes the last full-text item wins. Duplicate text can reuse SourceId, but changed text appends a new source snapshot. didClose removes document. Pump publishes only the still-current version; superseded or closed versions produce no notification. Server advertises UTF-16 positions and FULL text sync.
ingress.evidence: declared source behavior; append-only distinct versions are an explicit source comment/residual

ingress.stage: Production analysis backend, catalog and IDE query bridge
ingress.behavior: run_stdio constructs RealAnalysis::from_process. It loads catalog in order: explicit flag, nonempty CAN_CATALOG, cwd/can-catalog.json, cwd/packages/values/dist/catalog.json. Unreadable candidates are skipped; the first readable file is parsed/validated and its result is returned, so a malformed first readable file stops fallback. In this LSP path the explicit flag is None; load diagnostics are re-anchored for each open document. For a document, Snapshot parses, checks/types, resolves, and builds local query tables. Diagnostics combine analysis diagnostics, catalog-load diagnostics, and recommended lint findings for that file. Queries are single-document; source comments explicitly say cross-file references are not tracked. StubAnalysis returns empty data and is for hermetic lifecycle tests.
ingress.evidence: declared source behavior; catalog availability/default semantics should be checked against catalog loader before making claims beyond the stated environment/cwd inputs
